messages:
maria: Heads up — hotfix PR is ready but we need two reviewers before the deploy cutoff at 18:00 PT. PR https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/1254 — changed KV cache warmup fallback logic, small env var tweak. Please ping if you can take one.
ben: looking now, will run the smoke locally and flag anything
sam: @ben if you see perf regression call me, otherwise i can sign off after smoke
deploy-bot: CI passed — all checks green (unit, integration), canary pending
ben: smoke passed on my machine, no regressions seen. left one nit in the diff about a log line
maria: thanks @ben — can you add a quick tweak? we can still merge before cutoff if we get one more approval
anna: I can do the second review in ~20m, will do a quick read and perf check
josh: reassigning PR to @anna per request
anna: reviewed, added a suggestion on the log formatting, approve after it's applied :thumbsup:
maria: @sam gonna merge after @anna's suggestion is applied and CI green — note: we need to tag release candidate `rc-hotfix-1254`
sam: will merge and trigger canary at t+5min, will monitor latency for 15m — tagging @oncall in case of fallout
oncall: acknowledged — i'll be watching traces and error rates
maria: thanks everyone — if we don't get the second approval by 18:00 PT we'll hold to next slot and avoid autoretry
ben: PR updated with log tweak, pushed
anna: approved and 👍 merged permissions ready
sam: merging now
deploy-bot: Merge completed by sam — canary started
maria: monitoring. thanks all!
